First Year Seminar Series 2026 (CME 300)

Tuesdays 1:30-2:45 PM - September 22nd to December 1st 2026
Autumn Quarter 2026

Event Details:

Tuesday, September 22, 2026 - Tuesday, December 1, 2026

Location

Stanford Campus
United States

This event is open to:

Students

Weekly presentations by Stanford faculty on their current research. Required for first-year ICME Ph.D. students; recommended for first-year ICME M.S. students interested in research.

If you have any questions, please contact Professor Alison Marsden redacted@example.edu.
